name: Dog Selfie Maker
author: hearth-team
description: Generate a 9:16 vertical iPhone-style selfie of a dog — deliberately ordinary, with awkward framing or candid imperfection. Uses OpenAI gpt-image-2. The default prompt is editable from Configure Skill (override) and falls back when cleared.
prompt_template: A vertical 9:16 ordinary iPhone snapshot of a dog taking a selfie in a casual setting, with some accessory/prop, an awkward or goofy candid expression (tongue out, wonky ears, head-tilt), and an imperfection like blur, bad framing, slobber on the lens, clutter, or harsh lighting. Avoid cinematic, polished, professional, or glamour-style composition.

vault_inputs.label: Prompt template
vault_inputs.placeholder: Leave blank to use the default dog-selfie prompt baked into this skill.
vault_inputs.help: Override the default image-generation prompt. Clear the box to fall back to the skill's bundled default. Stored encrypted in your local vault.

vault_inputs.label: Preferred image model
vault_inputs.help: Shared by OpenAI image generation and cat/dog selfies. Blank uses gpt-image-2. Refresh lists supported models available to your key; it does not generate images. Save configuration to apply.

vault_inputs.label: Fallback image model (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Blank disables fallback. Used only when the preferred model is unavailable or incompatible with transparency. No retry for quota, authentication, moderation or network errors. Pricing depends on the model used.
